It was founded in 2000 and claims to be the first trust bank in Japan to be exclusively engaged in asset administration business.{{Cite web|url=http://www.mastertrust.co.jp/english/index.html|title=GREETINGS|last=|first=|date=|website=mastertrust.co.jp|publisher=The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd.|access-date=2016-12-13}} The company's shareholders are [[Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation]] (46.5%), [[Nippon Life|Nippon Life Insurance]] (33.5%), [[Meiji Yasuda Life|Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance]] (10%) and [[Norinchukin Bank|Norinchukin Trust & Banking Co.]] (10%).{{Cite web|url=http://www.mastertrust.co.jp/english/corporate.html|title=Corporate Overview (as of Jun. 28, 2016)|last=|first=|date=|website=www.mastertrust.co.jp|publisher=The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd.|access-date=2016-12-13}} Master Trust Bank is treated as a consolidated [[subsidiary]] of Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking, and is by extension part of the [[Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.tr.mufg.jp/english/aboutmutb/company/group.html|title=Group Companies in Japan : Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking|website=tr.mufg.jp|access-date=2016-12-13}} It is one of the three main [[Master Trust|master trust]] service providers in Japan, alongside [[Trust & Custody Services Bank]] (affiliated with [[Mizuho Financial Group|Mizuho]]) and [[Japan Trustee Services Bank]] (affiliated with [[Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group|SMFG]]).{{Cite web|url=https://www.pfa.or.jp/yogoshu/ma/ma03.html|title=マスタートラスト｜用語集｜企業年金連合会|website=pfa.or.jp|access-date=2016-12-13}} == Shares == By the end of 2016, the Master Trust Bank of Japan had about 4.9 percent of the Japanese advertiser ''Dentsu, Inc.''Kommission zur Ermittlung der Konzentration im Medienbereich: [https://www.kek-online.de/fileadmin/user_upload/KEK/Publikationen/Jahresberichte/19._Jahresbericht.pdf Jahresbericht 2016/2017, Page 71] (German, PDF-file, 2,9 MB), Retrieved 14. January 2024. At the end of 2022, it held circa 15.4 percent shares of [[Toyo Tires]], which according to revenue was the tenth biggest [[Tire|manufacturer of tires]] in the world.{{cite web |url=https://www.marklines.com/en/top500/toyo-tire#history |title=Toyo Tire Corporation (Formerly Toyo Tire & Rubber Co., Ltd.) – MarkLines Automotive Industry Portal |work=marklines.com |date=2022-12-31 |access-date=2024-01-13}}{{cite web|access-date=2024-01-13|date=2023-06-14|title=Umsatzstärkste Reifenhersteller 2022|url=https://de.statista.com/statistik/daten/studie/223875/umfrage/umsatzstaerkste-reifenhersteller-weltweit|work=de.statista.com}} Furthermore, it respectively have two more powerful stakes of 17% in the Japanese investment company [[SoftBank Group]] and 10% in SoftBank Corp, a consolidated subsidiary of the SoftBank Group.{{cite web |first=Mensholong |last=Lepcha |url=https://capital.com/softbank-shareholder-who-owns-most-sftby-stock |title=Softbank Shareholders, Who Owns The Most Shares of Softbank? |work=capital.com |date=2022-11-23 |access-date=2024-01-14}}{{cite web |url=https://www.softbank.jp/en/corp/ir/stock/info/#:~:text=Table_title:%20Principal%20shareholders%20(as%20of%20September%2030%2C,Class%20Shares%20%7C%20Holding%20Ratio%20(%25):%20%7C |title=SoftBank Corp Full Shareholders List |work=softbank.jp |date=2025-09-30 |access-date=2026-02-26}} In addition as of September 30 2025, the Master Trust Bank of Japan also has another powerful 15% stake in [[All Nippon Airways|Japan's largest airline and flag carrier All Nippon Airways (ANA)]] where it also has the most shares in the airline.{{cite web |url=https://www.ana.co.jp/group/en/investors/stock/situation.html#:~:text=HOME,Number%20of%20Shares%20held%20(Thousands) |title=ANA Shareholder Information |work=ana.co.jp |date=2025-09-30 |access-date=2026-02-26}} == History == Master Trust Bank was founded in 2000 with investments from Mitsubishi Trust Bank, Nippon Life Insurance, Toyo Trust Bank, Meiji Life Insurance and [[Deutsche Bank]]. A month after its founding, it became the first Japanese asset administrator to offer online information reporting services.{{Cite web|url=http://www.mastertrust.co.jp/company/pdf/discro_2016.pdf|title=2016ディスクロージャー誌|last=|first=|date=|website=mastertrust.co.jp|publisher=The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd.|access-date=}} == References == ==External links== *[http://www.mastertrust.co.jp/ The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd.] {{in lang|ja}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Master Trust Bank of Japan}} [[Category:Financial services companies based in Tokyo]] [[Category:Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group]] [[Category:Banks established in 1985]] [[Category:Trust banks of Japan]] [[Category:Meiji Yasuda Life]] [[Category:Nippon Life]] [[Category:Japanese companies established in 1985]]

The Master Trust Bank of Japan, Ltd. (日本マスタートラスト信託銀行株式会社, Nippon Masutā Torasuto Shintaku Ginkō Kabushiki-gaisha) is a trust bank in Japan. It was founded in 2000 and claims to be the first trust bank in Japan to be exclusively engaged in asset administration business.
The company's shareholders are Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation (46.5%), Nippon Life Insurance (33.5%), Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance (10%) and Norinchukin Trust & Banking Co. (10%). Master Trust Bank is treated as a consolidated subsidiary of Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking, and is by extension part of the Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group.
It is one of the three main master trust service providers in Japan, alongside Trust & Custody Services Bank (affiliated with Mizuho) and Japan Trustee Services Bank (affiliated with SMFG).
